digest.component_or_area: bridge state (.bridge_state) committed format and migrations
propositions: Three format changes (A2: last_get_pass relocation, A3: scalar baseline normalization, A4-2: prev_snapshot narrowing) must be documented as an ADR with rollback boundaries and mixed-version protocol.
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
Mixed-version read protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) to safely transition; first-wins is unsafe and legacy must be stopped and scrubbed only after direct deployment evidence.

A2-2 cutover gate requires A2-1 merge, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle; no pass-record version stamp exists so direct evidence replaces elapsed time.
Assignee field is excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
Measured cost reduction: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB after A1, with 218/399 identical prev key sets, cited from session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
